No persons shall in any legal proceedings be permit-Certain com· ted or compelled to produce or disclose any communication munications to be prior oral which has taken place between the Commis-vileged sion or any of its members and the Government or any or any communication between members of the Commission in exercise of or in connection with the of its functions unless His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan shall in writing consent to such production or disclosure.

Every member of the Commission shall have such and like protection and privileges in case of any action or suit brought against him for any act done or omitted to be done by him when acting in the execution of his office as is by law given to any magistrate acting in the execution of his

Any person who, in connection with an application by any person for employment or appointment in the public to Commission service or with the exercise by the Commission of any of its functions, wilfully gives to the Commission or to any memor to any person or body of persons appointed by the Commission to assist in the exercise of its functions any information which is false or misleading in any material particular shall be guilty of an offence: Penalty, a fine of $10,000 and imprisonment for 2 years.

(1) No member of the Commission nor any other person shall, withoy.t the written permission of His Highsure of in-or disclose to any unauthorised person or otherwise than in the course of duty the contents or any part of the contents of any document, communication or information whatsoever which has come to his knowledge in the course of his duty as such member in respect of any matters relating to the exercise by the Commission of any of its functions, and any person who knowingly acts in contravention of the provisions of this subsection shall be guilty of an offence: Penalty, a fine of $5,000 and imprisonment for one year.

(2) If any person having possession of any information which to his knowledge has been disclosed in contravention of the provisions of this section publishes or communicates such information to any person otherwise than of a prosecution under this Act, he shall be guilty of an offence : Penalty, a fine of $5,000 and imprisonment for one year.

(3) The salaries, allowances, privileges and other terms of office of members of the Commission shall not be altered to their disadvantage after their appointment. of re-11. The sum required for the remuneration payable under this Act shall be charged on the Consolidated Fund. -"

A person to whom any salary is payable under this Act or for whose salary as the holder of any other office is made by any other written law shall be entitled to receive only one such salary, but if he is the holder of two or more offices in respect of which salary is so payable in of those offices, the office in respect of which salary is payable to him shall be that in respect of which the highest is payable.
